stem: What is the best summary of paragraphs 5 through 9?

options.label: A
options.text: The narrator and Josiah are reconstructing the roof of a neighboring house. When the narrator notices his father watching, he begins to question the quality of his work. When the narrator drops a board, he is glad to see that his father did not witness the mistake.

options.label: B
options.text: The narrator is working on reconstructing the roof of a neighboring house with Josiah. He notices that his father has come out to watch him work. The narrator begins to wonder about the work he is doing on the house.

options.label: C
options.text: The narrator notices that his father is sleeping while he and Josiah are reconstructing the roof of a neighboring house. He sees his father watching them later in the day, but his father does not offer to help the boys. The narrator wonders if his father will criticize his work.

options.label: D
options.text: The narrator notices that his father is watching him reconstruct the roof of a house with Josiah. The narrator becomes anxious and drops a board Josiah is passing to him. The board almost hits Josiah, who is not pleased with his brother's carelessness.
